name: BankBridge
description: Answer questions about your own US bank, credit card and investment accounts from any MCP agent, including ones running a local model.
compatibility: MCP clients that support Streamable HTTP, with OAuth 2.1 or a bearer key from the BankBridge dashboard. The model needs reliable tool calling.
limitations: Hosted, closed-source server; the repository holds the client package and skill. Paid service, $5/mo per connected bank. US banks only.
With a local model the conversation stays on your machine, but balances and transactions still pass through a bank-data provider and bankbridge.money, which keeps no copy. Not an offline tool.
Read-only: no tool can move money, pay a bill or place a trade.
